 At Oolio,
 **Senior QA Engineers**

description:
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Analyst to lead manual testing efforts for the Customer Portal, a React/AEM\-based web application integrated with SAP, Salesforce, and supporting middleware. The QA will validate end\-to\-end business scenarios spanning the web/AEM front end and SAP\-driven backend processes (orders, deliveries, invoices, documents), ensuring the portal meets functional, data\-accuracy, and customer\-experience requirements before release.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Test Planning \& Strategy: Define the manual test strategy and test plans for each Phase 1 module (Profile, Documents, Contact Us, Dashboard, Deliveries, Order Status), covering functional, regression, integration, and UAT\-support testing.
* Test Case Design: Author detailed test cases and test scripts derived from business requirement documents, including field\-level validations, business rules, and source\-system mappings (e.g., SAP, SFDC).
* SAP\-Integrated Scenario Testing: Validate portal behavior against SAP\-driven data and logic, including order status transitions, delivery commitment / delay logic, credit/pricing/compliance blocks, invoice and document availability, and output management triggers.
* Web/UI Testing: Perform functional, cross\-browser, responsive, and accessibility testing of the React/AEM front end, including forms, search/filter behavior, modals, file uploads/downloads, and navigation flows.
* Data Validation: Verify data accuracy and consistency across SAP, Salesforce (SFDC), and the portal UI, including account details, contact information, order/delivery data, and document metadata.
* Defect Management: Log, triage, and track defects to closure using the team's defect management tool, working closely with React developers, AEM SMEs, and SAP consultants on root cause and resolution.
* Requirement Traceability: Maintain requirements\-to\-test\-case traceability matrices to ensure full coverage of documented requirements and sign\-off criteria.
* Regression \& Release Testing: Execute regression test cycles ahead of each release, validate bug fixes, and provide go/no\-go quality input to the Project Lead.
* UAT Support: Support business stakeholders during User Acceptance Testing, including test data preparation, issue triage, and coordination of retesting.
* Documentation: Maintain clear test documentation, execution logs, and status reporting (pass/fail metrics, defect trends, coverage) for project stakeholders.


**Must\-Have Skills**
* Experience: 5\+ years of manual QA experience with at least 2\+ years testing applications integrated with SAP and modern web front ends.
* SAP Exposure: Working knowledge of SAP Sales \& Distribution (Order\-to\-Cash) processes – Sales Orders, Deliveries, Billing/Invoicing, Customer Master – sufficient to validate business rules and data displayed on the portal.
* Web Application Testing: Hands\-on experience testing React\-based or other modern JavaScript web applications, including responsive/cross\-browser testing; exposure to CMS/DXP platforms such as AEM is a plus.
* Test Management Tools: Proficiency with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA/Xray, Azure DevOps, qTest, or similar).
* API/Integration Awareness: Ability to validate data flowing through REST/GraphQL APIs and integration layers (e.g., Apigee) at a functional level, using tools such as Postman.
* CRM Exposure: Familiarity with Salesforce (SFDC) data structures (Accounts, Contacts, Cases) as they relate to customer and case data shown on the portal.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to design test scenarios covering complex business/status logic (e.g., order and delivery lifecycle states).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for defect reporting and stakeholder coordination.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams, including participation in sprint ceremonies and Definition of Done reviews.


**Added Advantage (Highly Preferred)**
* Experience testing AEM (Sites/SPA Editor) authored pages and AEM Dispatcher\-cached content.
* Exposure to SAP transaction codes relevant to customer master and order data (e.g., XD03\) for cross\-verification during testing.
* Experience testing Salesforce Case creation/workflow integrations.
* Basic SQL knowledge for backend data verification.
* ISTQB Foundation Level certification.


**Qualifications**
* B.E / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent.
* ISTQB or equivalent QA certification is a plus.

 In addition, the Senior Quality Assurance Engineer will support key Quality Management System (QMS) administration activities related to design and development. This includes conducting internal quality audits to verify compliance with internal procedures and global regulatory expectations, as well as leading or supporting Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), including verifying effectiveness and ensuring all remediation activities are properly documented. The role will manage Process Change Control for design‑related processes, ensuring changes are appropriately evaluated, documented, reviewed, and approved. Further responsibilities include assisting functional teams in understanding their quality obligations and maintaining alignment with the Spacelabs Quality Policy, as well as maintaining and improving QMS procedures, work instructions, and templates to ensure practices remain risk‑based, efficient, and compliant.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Sr. Quality Assurance Engineer shall follow the guidance of RA/QA Management and help other organizational functions understand and fulfill their obligations to meet quality objectives, systemic responsibilities, and customer requirements, as defined by Executive Management in the Spacelabs Quality Policy. As part of maintenance of the Spacelabs Quality Management System, Senior Quality Assurance Engineers shall partake in some or all of the following responsibilities:

* Shall participate in cross\-functional design teams to review all Design and Development Plans, Design Inputs, Design Outputs, V\&V documents, and Design Changes including Defect Reports. Senior Quality Assurance Engineers shall recognize potential impacts to health or device efficacy (“Safety Issues”), support criticality assessment needed to ensure the application of reasonable and required Risk Management, Verification and Validation, and adequate record\-keeping practices.
* Uphold the company’s core values of Integrity, Innovation, Accountability, and Teamwork.
* Demonstrate behavior consistent with the company’s Code of Ethics and Conduct.
